plugins.name: hatchable
plugins.description: Build, deploy, and run full-stack web apps from Claude Code. Every project gets a live URL, a dedicated PostgreSQL database, auth, cron, email, and storage. No build step, no infrastructure. After installing, run /mcp and sign in to Hatchable to connect (free).

skills.name: fix
skills.description: Diagnose and fix a failing Hatchable deploy or a broken deployed app. Use when a Hatchable deploy is rejected, a deployed app errors, or the user reports their Hatchable app is broken.
skills.description_zh: 诊断并修复 Hatchable 部署拒绝、线上应用报错或功能损坏。

skills.name: import
skills.description: Deploy the current local project to Hatchable. Use when the user wants to import, migrate, publish, or host an existing repo or working directory on Hatchable.
skills.description_zh: 将现有本地仓库或工作目录导入、迁移、发布到 Hatchable 托管。

skills.name: new
skills.description: Create and deploy a live, shareable web app on Hatchable from a plain-language request. Use when the user asks to build, make, create, spin up, or prototype an app, site, tool, dashboard, form, or MVP they want running at a real URL, even if they never name Hatchable. Not for compiling or bundling an existing codebase (that is a local build step), and not for code meant to stay local.
headings: Build a new app on Hatchable
Step 0: confirm the connection before building anything
Then follow the build loop, in this order
skills.description_zh: 从自然语言创建并部署可通过真实 URL 分享的 Hatchable 网站、应用、工具、仪表盘、表单或 MVP；不用于既有代码单纯编译打包或仅本地代码。
